policy: Crate versions and licenses are retained. These are reviewed source patches, not version renames or advisory ignores. Remove each patch when a compatible upstream release includes the corresponding fix.

patches.change: Backport gtk-rs-core PR 1343: pass a mutable pointer slot to g_variant_get_child.
Remove proc-macro-error and report diagnostics through the existing syn::Error API. Cover invalid parser input without unwinding.

glibScannerNote: Version-only scanners may still report glib 0.18.5. Its RUSTSEC-2024-0429 fix is backported here because Tauri GTK3 requires the 0.18 ABI.

unaffectedAdvisories.reason: The installed version is outside the upstream affected range. OSV currently reports an overly broad introduced=0 range; no dependency substitution or audit suppression is applied.

verification.linux: Build tests/linux-security/Dockerfile, mount the checkout read-only at /workspace, and run sh /workspace/tests/linux-security/check.sh. /verification is a disposable build cache; /registry-seed may supply a read-only Cargo registry cache.
